contents.name: Local and relative Hodge theory of Soergel bimodules ([W2, EW3] of the survey): the page builds only the global Hodge theory needed for the type-A character theorem; the local/relative forms and their applications to the Jantzen conjectures are a separate planned subject and no item on this pair consumes them.
contents.reason: The category-O and intersection-cohomology consequences are supplied by the in-run page the-kazhdan-lusztig-character-and-multiplicity-theorem, which this pair does not replace; duplicating them here would exceed the approved scope.

contents.name: The algebraic proof of the Kazhdan-Lusztig conjecture for category O and the identification with intersection cohomology of Schubert varieties: these are consequences for the later pages (the Kazhdan-Lusztig character and multiplicity theorem) and are not reformulated as items here; only the positivity and character consequences are included.
contents.reason: The approved design scope is the type-A (finite) case with the standard realization; the general Coxeter statements are recorded by the sources but not claimed by any item of this pair.

contents.name: The general Coxeter group and arbitrary reflection faithful realization statements: the page is deliberately specialized to type A (the design scope), and no item claims the general Coxeter case; the sources' general statements are used only through their type-A instances.
contents.reason: The approved design scope of this pair is the finite type-A case with the standard reflection realization; the general Coxeter-group and arbitrary-realization statements of the sources are motivation and context, no item of the pair claims them, and the type-A instances are the only ones consumed by the items.
